usedFor: HeySummit holds your event attendees, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Each registration starts a command you chose on your computers, so setup on your machine runs itself.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” acts on your computers, so test it on one registration before pointing it at a live event.
